about: Add a host's join command, written once for every end that builds it. Hand-written, not generated: change a command here first, then make the web (apps/web/src/widgets/account/join-command.test.ts), server (apps/server/test/join-command.test.ts) and iOS (HostLinkTests.swift) tests pass again. Cases without a token are the copy the clients build (the host prints a code to confirm); cases with one are what the server returns from POST /api/join-tokens, where <token> stands for the minted token.
